name: Warwick Chancellor's International Scholarship
amount: Full tuition fees + maintenance stipend at UKRI rate (UKRI rate cited by Warwick departments: £21,805/yr)
dlText: 10 Dec 2026 (scholarship form; time not stated) – PhD application by 7 Dec 2026
tags: Part of Warwick PGR Scholarship Competition

eligibility.note: International (overseas fee status) applicants to Warwick doctoral programmes; check the Doctoral College page for current fee-status rules.

note: Awarded through Warwick's central PGR Scholarship Competition. Department pages list 7 Dec 2026 for the course application and 10 Dec 2026 for the scholarship application for 2027 entry.

name: St Leonard's Masters Scholarship (International)
host: University of St Andrews (St Leonard's College)
amount: Top tier: full tuition + stipend; other tiers 75% or 25–50% tuition reduction

eligibility.note: International (overseas fee status) applicants to St Andrews taught master's programmes; tiers based on merit and widening-participation criteria.

note: The 'Global Widening Participation' tier covers full tuition plus a stipend; lower tiers give 75% or 25–50% fee reductions.

name: St Leonard's College World-Leading Doctoral Scholarships
host: University of St Andrews (St Leonard's College)
amount: Full tuition + doctoral stipend (2027-28 rate to be confirmed by end Dec 2026)
note: Six scholarships are for supervisor-defined projects and six for applicants proposing their own project. Open to home and international applicants.

name: CEU Master's Financial Aid (Tuition Award + Stipend)
amount: Tuition award typically 50–80% of fees (full only in exceptional cases) + stipend €300–750/month
dlText: 2 Feb 2027 (admission Round 2; time not stated) – Round 1 closed 15 Oct 2026
nextText: Aid also offered in Round 1 (mid-Oct) of the next cycle

eligibility.note: Any nationality; in Round 2 financial aid is not open to applicants from CEU's 'visa-sensitive' countries (they must apply in Round 1).

fields: CEU master's programmes (social sciences, humanities, public policy, economics, environment, law)
note: Master's aid is merit-based. Some programmes (e.g. 2-year MA Economics, Data and Policy) advertise full tuition waivers plus €10,000/yr for top applicants.

name: Master Mind Scholarships (Flemish Government)
host: Flemish Ministry of Education (via Flemish universities and colleges)
amount: €10,225/year grant + tuition waiver (2026-27 terms; under review for 2027-28)
dlText: Varies by host institution: e.g. KU Leuven 15 Jan 2027, 23:59 CET; others Feb–Apr

eligibility.note: Students of (nearly) all nationalities admitted to an eligible master's; students already enrolled at or graduated from a Flemish institution are excluded. Check host institution rules.

fields: Eligible master's programmes at Flemish institutions
note: Study in Flanders says the scheme is under review for 2027-28, so terms may change. Apply through the host institution (KU Leuven, UGent, UAntwerp, VUB, etc.), each with its own deadline.

name: KU Leuven Inspiring the Outstanding Scholarship
amount: Full tuition waiver (pay ~€140 admin fee) + €13,200/academic year, max 2 years

eligibility.note: International applicants to eligible KU Leuven master's programmes; check the 2027-2028 page for nationality conditions.

note: One application covers the Inspiring the Outstanding, Master Mind and KU Leuven ASEAN scholarships. Results end of March 2027.

name: Radboud Scholarship Programme
amount: Tuition reduced from institutional fee (~€15,000–25,000) to statutory fee (~€2,771)
fields: English-taught Radboud master's in participating faculties
note: For a master's starting 1 Sep 2027. Decisions before mid-April 2027.

name: Tilburg University Waiver (50% tuition)
dlText: 1 Apr 2027 (waiver form + programme application; time not stated)

eligibility.note: Applicants paying the institutional fee for a regular one-year Tilburg master's; check the waiver page for exact criteria.

note: Halves tuition for a September 2027 start. If more eligible applicants apply than waivers are available, recipients are chosen by random lottery.

name: VU Fellowship Programme (VUFP)
amount: Covers tuition fees (check official page for exact terms)
note: Apply via the VUFP-NLS form after conditional admission; VU advises submitting the master's application by 1 Dec 2026.

name: Erasmus Trustfonds Scholarship (Erasmus School of Economics)
host: Erasmus University Rotterdam – Erasmus School of Economics
amount: Up to €17,500 (tuition waiver + living allowance + one-off allowance)
dlText: 31 Jan / 1 Feb 2027 (pages differ; use 31 Jan 23:59 CET)
tags: Not for current ESE master's students
fields: Economics and econometrics master's at ESE
note: Open to EEA and non-EEA students with excellent grades. Non-EEA tuition for 2027-28 is about €22,800, so the award covers most costs for EEA and much for non-EEA.

name: Philip Hans Franses Scholarship
host: Erasmus University Rotterdam – Erasmus School of Economics
amount: €12,000 tuition waiver for first year (of ~€22,800 non-EEA fee)
fields: Economics and econometrics master's at ESE
note: Partial tuition waiver for non-EEA master's students at Erasmus School of Economics; same window as the Trustfonds scholarship.

name: Wageningen University Excellence Scholarship
amount: Full tuition fee waiver for 24 months (~€22,560/yr est. 2027-28); living costs not covered
dlText: Complete MSc application before 1 Dec 2026 (time not stated)

eligibility.note: Non-EU/EFTA nationals from a set list of countries; dual EU/EFTA nationals excluded. Check the list on the WUR page.

fields: Wageningen on-campus MSc (life sciences, agriculture, food, environment)
note: No separate scholarship form: eligible applicants with a complete application by 1 Dec 2026 and unconditional admission are considered. September start only.

name: WUR Africa Scholarship Programme (ASP)
dlText: Complete MSc application before 1 Dec 2026; invited scholarship application by 1 May 2027

eligibility.note: Citizens of African countries applying for a Wageningen MSc.

note: Applicants with a complete MSc application by 1 Dec 2026 and unconditional admission may be invited to apply; the scholarship application is then due 1 May 2027.

name: TU/e Scholarship for Excellence: Shaping the Future of Microchip Innovation
host: Eindhoven University of Technology (TU/e) / TSH Talent Foundation
tags: Applied Physics, EE, ME, Math & CS

eligibility.note: Applicants to selected TU/e master's programmes; check the page for nationality rules.

fields: Applied Physics, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mathematics & Computer Science
note: Applicants with a complete application by 1 Jan 2027 are automatically considered. The award amount is not shown in search results; confirm on TU/e's page.

name: Ghent University BOF Doctoral Scholarships for Candidates from the Global South
amount: ~€2,850/month for 24 months at Ghent (other 24 months co-funded by home institution)
dlText: 9 Feb 2027, 23:59 Belgian time (exception requests by 15 Jan 2027)

eligibility.note: Nationals of the Global South countries listed in the call, with a partner institution in the South.

note: Mandatory co-funding for the 24 months spent at the partner university. Earliest start 1 Oct 2027; results from 12 May 2027.

name: Bocconi Graduate Merit Award
dlText: Considered with MSc application; Round II closes 26 Jan 2027, 15:00 CET (Round I closed 29 Oct 2026)
fields: Bocconi MSc programmes (economics, finance, management, data science, AI, law)
note: Merit-based full tuition waiver for first-year MSc applicants. Later rounds close 11 Mar and 29 Apr 2027 but fewer awards remain.
